requestedIntent: Installed target repos must show which ACEF source version they use and have a mechanical update path.

docs: CHANGELOG.md#Unreleased — Host fork gates ported upstream; updates keep host-modified files (2026-10-27)

limitations: ACEF does not yet have a semantic release number; the installed version is the source checkout path plus git commit and dirty/clean state.
The target-local update command requires the recorded source checkout path to remain available.

evidence.note: 2026-10-27: host-modified tool, hook and skill files kept and reported; unmodified copies replaced; model routing policy merged three-way (host overrides kept, untouched ACEF values upgraded, new keys added; fork installs keep all values); stale Python-tool .cjs removed only when unmodified; legacy records use the recorded install commit, including another ACEF checkout.
